name: Mori
shortDescription: A village-style collection of two-storey modern pool villas in the Si Sunthon / Bang Jo area.
description: A village-style collection of two-storey modern pool villas in the Si Sunthon / Bang Jo area. The 3BR plan has parking, living, dining and kitchen downstairs, with a master suite, two bedrooms and a multi-purpose room upstairs.

researchNotes: Official site not found. Papaya says 'furniture' feature and private pool optional/included ambiguously. Keller Henson lists Mori 2 The Valley under Bang Tao area with 47 units; a property portal says Mori has 118 units. Images are brochure images, appear to be renders. | Papaya Property lists Mori from THB 13,048,000 (3BR 229 sqm). Keller Henson lists the related 'Mori 2 The Valley' from THB 16.67M (range 16.7-20.6M), closer to the claim of 16.3M. Claim not exactly confirmed; project identity (Mori vs Mori 2 The Valley) unclear. | claimed price 16300000 | Phase 4 (2026-11-19) a property portal fields filled where empty: totalUnits, completionDate. a property portal is a portal; values not confirmed by the developer. Property portal audit 2026-11-21: starting price, units advertised, completion, floors/buildings and unit table taken from the portal project and listing pages (unit table replaced). Nearby places refreshed 2026-11-23: beaches, hospitals, big stores (Tesco Lotus, Big C, Makro), markets, schools and kindergartens added from OpenStreetMap as straight-line distances from the FazWaz project coordinates (not road distance). Where a category already had a distance from the developer or a portal, it was kept and not replaced.
